environment.description: Same EKS cluster with Istio 1.19.3. PeerAuthentication resource in 'payments-ns' enforces STRICT mTLS. An AuthorizationPolicy in 'payments-ns' specifies: action DENY for requests where source.namespace is not in ['payments-ns', 'orchestration-ns']. A second AuthorizationPolicy with action ALLOW requires source.principal matching 'cluster.local/ns/orchestration-ns/sa/step-functions-invoker'. The workflow-task-handler in 'workflow-ns' uses service account 'workflow-task-sa'. Envoy access log filter configured with '%REQ(TRANSFER-ENCODING)%' field logged but NOT stripped. Mesh-wide EnvoyFilter resource applies header normalization only on inbound listeners in 'orchestration-ns' (not 'payments-ns'). The DENY policy on namespace mismatch executes before any header processing at the upstream Envoy.

envoy_filter_header_normalization.note: normalize_path and header case normalization on inbound only
